description: The five LDA topic membership weights sum to one for each article.
rationale: The metadata defines LDA_00 through LDA_04 as a five-topic probability distribution, whose components are normalized to sum to one.

fix_code.code:
def fix(df):
    return 1.0 - df['LDA_01'] - df['LDA_02'] - df['LDA_03'] - df['LDA_04']

def fix(df):
    return 1.0 - (df['LDA_00'] + df['LDA_02'] + df['LDA_03'] + df['LDA_04'])

def fix(df):
    return 1.0 - df['LDA_00'] - df['LDA_01'] - df['LDA_03'] - df['LDA_04']

def fix(df):
    return 1.0 - (df['LDA_00'] + df['LDA_01'] + df['LDA_02'] + df['LDA_04'])

def fix(df):
    return 1.0 - df['LDA_00'] - df['LDA_01'] - df['LDA_02'] - df['LDA_03']

description: The positive and negative sentiment-bearing word rates sum to one.
rationale: These two columns partition sentiment-bearing words into positive and negative categories, and the preprocessing removed rows with no such words.

description: Absolute title subjectivity equals the absolute distance of title subjectivity from 0.5.
rationale: The processed feature is explicitly defined as the magnitude of the title subjectivity deviation from the neutral midpoint 0.5.

description: Absolute title sentiment polarity equals the magnitude of title sentiment polarity.
rationale: The processed feature is explicitly defined as the absolute value of the signed title sentiment-polarity score.
